note: Third-sector (järjestö) talking support — the peer-community rung. This is NOT the crisis path: any safety flag bypasses this rung entirely and goes to Kriisipuhelin 09 2525 0111 / 112 (invariant 8). Hours below were checked against the live source on 2026-09-08; where a source could not be read, the entry carries the honest 'check the site' fallback rather than an invented hour. No service is added here without clinician review.

entries.note: The default rung-2 entry. Verified 2026-09-08: run by MIELI ry, dozens of organisations operate on the platform, registration required but conversation is fully anonymous. Some Swedish and English content exists but the platform is primarily Finnish.

Formerly Solmussa-chat. Verified 2026-09-08: staffed by trained volunteers who complete crisis-support training, debriefed by MIELI crisis workers after every shift. Source states evenings Monday–Thursday but not exact times, so the hours string says so rather than inventing them.

Booked through Tukinet, at least 30 minutes in advance. Verified 2026-09-08: MIELI states a Finnish-language email gets a reply usually within a week and that English replies take longer — the cost note says this plainly rather than letting someone wait without knowing.

Hours verified 2026-09-08 against mieli.fi/sv: Mon and Wed 16–20, Tue/Thu/Fri 9–13. Staffed by crisis-work professionals, students in the field, and volunteers. This number also appears in config/crisis.json as the Swedish crisis line — the crisis path is unchanged; this entry is the non-crisis listing of the same service.

TWO CORRECTIONS to the V2 brief, both verified 2026-09-08 at arligttalat.fi. (1) It is a CHAT ONLY — there is no Ärligt talat Swedish-language crisis phone line; the Swedish crisis phone is MIELI's Kristelefonen, listed separately. (2) It is staffed by LICENSED PROFESSIONALS (psychologists, counsellors, sexual-health and eating-disorder specialists), not trained volunteers, and it is for ages 13–29, not adults generally. Needs clinician confirmation.

entries.operator: MIELI Suomen Mielenterveys ry and partners
entries.note: The youth entry, also used by the C4 youth handoff. Hours verified 2026-09-08 via partner organisations (sekasin.fi blocks automated fetches): Mon–Fri 9–24, Sat–Sun 15–24, ages 12–29, staffed by organisation professionals and trained volunteers. Swedish at sekasin.fi/sv/.

The peer-with-lived-experience option. Verified 2026-09-08: expert mental-health advice weekdays 12–15, and volunteers who have themselves experienced mental-health problems on Wednesday and Thursday evenings 18–20. Monthly group chat on the first Tuesday, 18–19:30. whoAnswers is 'mixed' because both are true depending on when you go — the hours string says which is which.

FALLBACK ONLY, English only, always rendered last (invariant 13). Included solely because no Finnish English-language on-demand peer chat exists 24/7. The site blocks automated fetches, so nothing about its hours is asserted. Its caution label is mandatory and renders with every appearance.
